notablePrerequisites: Bess has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Animation Module by paying {3} and tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bess.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Bess.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Bess trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
